messages:
alex: quick ping — can someone take a look at PR #4527? touches attention tiling + batching heuristic. want to merge today if perf numbers look good. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4527

riya: I'm out until 1pm PT but can glance after. what's failing in CI?

alex: unit tests pass; local perf-run shows ~1.8% token latency improvement on seq=512 but a small throughput regression for very large batches (2048). seeing a weird path in the kv-cache fallback too. need eyes on the kernel switch and the gating logic.

sam: can you paste the microbench command? I'll run it on my workstation GPU.

alex: sure — run: `./tools/bench_attn.sh --model gpt2-xl --seq 512 --iters 200` and set env `USE_TILING=1`. also check `tools/perf/compare.sh` for the diff.

ci-bot: perf-run triggered by @alex on branch runtime/attn-tiling-gate — queued on queue-3.

sam: running now. quick heads-up: if the kv-cache ABI changed we need to touch `include/kv_cache.h` so other modules don't silently link to old shapes.

kevin: left a tiny nit in the PR about `tile_stride` naming. not a blocker.

riya: I skimmed the perf graphs the bot posted — nice win at 512, but 2048 looks slightly worse. is that expected from tiling?

alex: yes, tiling favors mid-range seq lengths; for very long sequences the tiled kernel adds overhead. I meant to gate tiled kernel to seq <= 1024 but forgot to add the runtime gate in this patch. my mistake.

riya: please add the gate and re-run perf. also double-check kv header comment so Sam's point is addressed. For merge window, can we wait for 2 approvals before merging?

sam: LGTM after the gate + kv header fix; I'll approve once the perf numbers come back green. :thumbsup:

alex: pushed patch `runtime/attn-tiling-gate` with the seq<=1024 gate and fixed `include/kv_cache.h` comment. thanks. @ci-bot please rerun the perf matrix.

ci-bot: perf-run completed — seq=512: -1.9% latency, seq=1024: -0.8% latency, seq=2048: +0.6% latency, throughput stable within noise. full test matrix: all checks passed. report: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/perf/1839990123

riya: looks reasonable to me. approving now.

kevin: approve.

alex: thanks everyone. I'll merge after a 30m soak unless anyone objects. will monitor canary for any kv-cache regressions. :eyes:
